exclusions.statement: Current Plan carriers and their metadata/Draft-ID work remain a separate CA-P-1968 worklist; this artifact does not claim full Candidate #7 all-role coverage.
Only readable current C/A/R/M/E/D/O sources enter this bounded Subject mapping worklist; other roles remain visible in the source frontier and diagnostics.
_projection, applicable-methodology delivery mirrors, archive/archived, and draft/drafts paths are not source-frontier inputs.

carrier_storage.rule: carrier, storage, file/directory/database, filename, format, or path marker

content_roles_types.rule: explicit Content Role or Type path marker; checked before carrier markers

history_actor.rule: history, journal, actor, author, or revision marker

methodology_configuration.rule: methodology, configuration, Project, Extension, settings, or source marker

operations.rule: operation, workflow, action, execution, run, or tool-flow marker

other.rule: no earlier lexical routing marker matched

relations_subjects.rule: relation, Subject, target, or Graph relation/rule marker

policy_inventory_scope.canonical_subject_rule: Subject itself or Subject/Domain, Subject/Engineering, or Subject/Graph followed by a permitted operator or end-of-string.
policy_inventory_scope.current_status_rule: Readable frontmatter with a string own status other than Draft or Archived, case-insensitive; Active is not required.
policy_inventory_scope.plan_boundary: Plan carriers are excluded from remaining occurrences because CA-P-1968 separately owns Plan metadata and Draft-ID migration.
policy_inventory_scope.semantic_boundary: Canonical-looking values are counted outside remaining work but are not semantically certified; routing lanes do not propose target Subjects.
